notes: A. James Clark School of Engineering official Fall 2026 Electrical Engineering graduation plan. General-education slots (ENGL101, Oral Communication, Professional Writing, Scholarship in Practice, Humanities, History/Social Sciences) are left out: only the program's own requirements are audited here (they're covered by gen-ed-2026-27.ts). ENEE200 (Engineering Ethics) stays: the plan prints it in its Major Requirements column even though it also satisfies a Humanities/Big-Question gen-ed slot.
The Upper-level General Technical Elective slot (Junior Fall) is filled with MATH461 (Applied Nonlinear Dynamics, upper-level MATH), one of the prefixes the requirement allows.

The ENEE Technical Elective slots (Category A x1, Category B x1, Category C x1, plus four generic 'ENEE Elective' slots totaling 22 credits) are filled with: Category A = ENEE420 (3); Category B = ENEE445 (2); Category C = ENEE408A (3); Additional = ENEE425 (3), ENEE426 (3), ENEE460 (3), ENEE474 (3), ENEE486 (2). Any courses meeting each category's own minimum credits would satisfy the requirement equally.
